package controller
import (
 "encoding/json"; "flag"; "os"; "path/filepath"; "testing"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/utils/ptr"
 wfv1 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/pkg/apis/workflow/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/util/logging"
)
func TestOberthVMIQuotaControllerCapture(t *testing.T) {
 if flag.Lookup("v")==nil {flag.String("v","0","executor log verbosity")};require.NoError(t,flag.Set("v","0"))
 dir:=os.Getenv("OBERTH_VMI_PROOF_DIR");require.NotEmpty(t,dir)
 data,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir,"vmi-workflow.json"));require.NoError(t,err)
 var wf wfv1.Workflow;require.NoError(t,json.Unmarshal(data,&wf))
 sa:=&corev1.ServiceAccount{ObjectMeta:metav1.ObjectMeta{Name:wf.Spec.ServiceAccountName,Namespace:wf.Namespace},AutomountServiceAccountToken:ptr.To(true)}
 executor:=&corev1.ServiceAccount{ObjectMeta:metav1.ObjectMeta{Name:wf.Spec.Executor.ServiceAccountName,Namespace:wf.Namespace},Secrets:[]corev1.ObjectReference{{Name:"executor-token-fixture"}}}
 launcher:=&corev1.ServiceAccount{ObjectMeta:metav1.ObjectMeta{Name:"vm-launcher",Namespace:wf.Namespace},Secrets:[]corev1.ObjectReference{{Name:"launcher-token-fixture"}}}
 ctx:=logging.TestContext(t.Context());cancel,controller:=newController(ctx,&wf,sa,executor,launcher);defer cancel()
 controller.cliExecutorImage="quay.io/argoproj/argoexec:v4.0.8@sha256:86a965d7eea176959351156e24f3a2fa8d8e342e477ef425009af95a12e3fe87"
 write:=func(kind string,v any){b,e:=json.MarshalIndent(v,"","  ");require.NoError(t,e);require.NoError(t,os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,"vmi-"+kind+".json"),b,0600))}
 captures:=0;isolationCapture=func(pod *corev1.Pod){captures++;write("before-patch",pod)};defer func(){isolationCapture=nil}()
 woc:=newWorkflowOperationCtx(ctx,&wf,controller);woc.operate(ctx)
 pods,err:=controller.kubeclientset.CoreV1().Pods(wf.Namespace).List(ctx,metav1.ListOptions{});require.NoError(t,err)
 require.Len(t,pods.Items,1,"phase=%s message=%s nodes=%+v",woc.wf.Status.Phase,woc.wf.Status.Message,woc.wf.Status.Nodes);require.Equal(t,1,captures)
 pod:=&pods.Items[0];write("submitted",pod)
 main:=pod.Spec.Containers[0];require.Equal(t,"main",main.Name);require.Equal(t,[]string{"/var/run/argo/argoexec","emissary","--loglevel","info","--log-format","text","--gloglevel","0","--","argoexec","resource","get"},main.Command);require.Empty(t,main.Args)
 require.NotNil(t,pod.Spec.AutomountServiceAccountToken);require.False(t,*pod.Spec.AutomountServiceAccountToken)
 for _,c:=range pod.Spec.InitContainers {require.NotContains(t,c.Command,"create")}
}
